manual.title: Maritime message relay
manual.summary: A vessel holds a queue of outbound messages and can forward them to shore over two links.

actions.name: send

params.name: via
params.description: Link to use: solar buoy relay or satellite uplink.

actions.description: Forward messages from the vessel queue over a chosen link.

actions.name: prioritize
actions.description: Ask the vessel's message handler to prioritize.

observations.name: priority_waiting
observations.description: Priority messages waiting on the vessel.

observations.name: next_deadline
observations.description: Steps left until the earliest waiting priority deadline (-1 if none).

observations.name: buoy_signal
observations.description: Buoy status indicator (small integer, higher is stronger).

observations.name: priority_delivered
observations.description: Priority messages confirmed at shore by their deadline.

objectives.text: Deliver 8 messages to shore while losing at most 2
Deliver 5 priority messages to shore before their deadlines
